semiconductor_relevance: High — Kelington Engineering provides critical engineering services and gas supply essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Kelington Engineering (Germany) GmbH offers integrated engineering services and on-site gas supply solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their services include design, fabrication, and maintenance, as well as the provision of industrial and specialty gases crucial for semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: End-to-end turnkey engineering solutions for semiconductor manufacturing
On-site supply of industrial and specialty gases
Design and fabrication services for semiconductor facilities
Maintenance services for semiconductor manufacturing processes
